import FormalConjecturesUtil

namespace DiophantineTuple

variable {R : Type*} [Semiring R]

def IsDiophantineTuple (s : Finset R) : Prop :=
  (∀ x ∈ s, x ≠ 0) ∧
  ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ s, x ≠ y → IsSquare (x * y + 1)

abbrev IsIntegralDiophantineTuple (s : Finset ℕ) : Prop := IsDiophantineTuple (R := ℕ) s

theorem fermat_4_tuple : IsIntegralDiophantineTuple {1, 3, 8, 120} := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · decide
  · simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
    rintro x hx y hy hxy
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;> rcases hy with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;>
      first
      | exact absurd rfl hxy
      | exact ⟨2, rfl⟩
      | exact ⟨3, rfl⟩
      | exact ⟨11, rfl⟩
      | exact ⟨5, rfl⟩
      | exact ⟨19, rfl⟩
      | exact ⟨31, rfl⟩

end DiophantineTuple

import FormalConjecturesUtil

open ContDiff Set InnerProductSpace MeasureTheory EuclideanGeometry
open scoped Laplacian

namespace DeGiorgi

variable {n : ℕ} [NeZero n]

structure IsBoundedSolution (u : ℝ^n → ℝ) : Prop where
  regular : ContDiff ℝ 2 u
  bounded : ∃ C, ∀ x, |u x| ≤ C
  solution : ∀ x, (Δ u x) + u x - (u x) ^ 3 = 0

def HasPositiveDeriv (u : ℝ^n → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ x, 0 < lineDeriv ℝ u x (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1)

def HasHyperplaneLevelSets (u : ℝ^n → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ y ∈ range u, ∃ S : AffineSubspace ℝ (ℝ^n),
    u⁻¹' {y} = S ∧ Module.finrank ℝ S.direction = n - 1

def DeGiorgi_conclusion (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] : Prop :=
  ∀ u : ℝ^n → ℝ, (IsBoundedSolution u ∧ HasPositiveDeriv u) → HasHyperplaneLevelSets u

theorem DeGiorgi_one : (DeGiorgi_conclusion 1) := by
  intro u ⟨hu, hpos⟩
  set φ : ℝ → ℝ^1 := fun t => t • EuclideanSpace.single 0 1 with hφ
  have hφsurj : Function.Surjective φ := by
    intro x
    refine ⟨x 0, ?_⟩
    ext i
    have hi : i = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    subst hi
    simp [hφ]
  have hdiff : Differentiable ℝ u := hu.regular.differentiable (by norm_num)
  have hf : StrictMono (u ∘ φ) := by
    apply strictMono_of_deriv_pos
    intro t
    have h1 : HasDerivAt φ (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) t := by
      simpa [hφ] using (hasDerivAt_id t).smul_const (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 1) (1:ℝ))
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (u ∘ φ) (fderiv ℝ u (φ t) (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1)) t :=
      (hdiff (φ t)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t h1
    rw [h2.deriv]
    have := hpos (φ t)
    rwa [(hdiff (φ t)).lineDeriv_eq_fderiv] at this
  have hinj : Function.Injective u := by
    intro a b hab
    obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := hφsurj a
    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hφsurj b
    have : s = t := hf.injective hab
    rw [this]
  rintro y ⟨x₀, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨AffineSubspace.mk' x₀ ⊥, ?_, ?_⟩
  · ext p
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff, SetLike.mem_coe, AffineSubspace.mem_mk',
      Submodule.mem_bot, vsub_eq_zero_iff_eq]
    exact hinj.eq_iff
  · rw [AffineSubspace.direction_mk']
    simp

end DeGiorgi
